title: terminal.input payload
description: Learner keystroke/input data to write to the lab terminal's PTY. UTF-8 text only: xterm.js assembles keystrokes into complete Unicode scalar values before calling onData, so unlike terminal.output there is no split-multibyte-sequence concern on this side and no 'encoding' field (see contracts/schemas/websocket/README.md). This message does not map 1:1 onto a terminal.command event: many terminal.input messages (raw keystrokes) can precede one terminal.command event, and the terminal bridge, not the client, decides when a command is complete (e.g. on Enter) and assigns that event's idempotency_key itself. The envelope's idempotency_key is therefore optional/nullable for this type.
